quarantined_leads.lead: Former St. Lucie County Republican Executive Committee chair Kenneth Ford Nail was reported arrested in Martin County on a charge alleging unlawful harvesting of saw palmetto berries from public parks without a permit or landowner permission.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Former St. Lucie GOP chairman arrested in Martin County saw palmetto berry case
quarantined_leads.subject_response: No direct response from Nail concerning the August 25, 2026, palmetto-berry charge was located. The report says Nail previously denied knowing about alleged contraband in a separate 2025 correctional-facility case.
quarantined_leads.reason: CBS12 reports the arrest and explicitly documents Nail's former Republican Executive Committee chair role; the article attributes the facts to a probable-cause affidavit and Martin County sheriff's arrest reports. A substantially similar Treasure Coast Newspapers report syndicated through AOL was also reviewed, but no person-specific official booking or affidavit record was independently obtained, no current subject response was located, and the underlying arrest occurred August 25, outside the strict rolling window. Retain for follow-up and do not publish from this pass.
